name: Vespid Dynamics Perimeter Alert Micro-Drone Network PAMN-2
product_name: Vespid Dynamics Perimeter Alert Micro-Drone Network PAMN-2
description: A set of 20 micro-drones that establish an automated perimeter surveillance network, orbiting a designated area and alerting the operator to any intrusion. The PAMN-2 drones are the size of large moths and operate silently at night, using thermal and motion sensors to detect human-sized movement within the perimeter. When an intrusion is detected, the nearest drone illuminates the target with IR for identification while transmitting an alert to the operator's neural interface. The network automatically repositions to maintain coverage if individual drones are lost.

specifications.alert: Neural interface notification with IR illumination
specifications.weight: 1.5 kg for complete set with charger

story_hooks: A PAMN-2 network detected an intrusion that the drones could not identify — the thermal signature was there but the shape was not human, and the movement pattern did not match any known animal.
Someone deployed PAMN-2 drones around a rival's home to monitor their daily patterns — the surveillance was detected when a neighbor noticed moths flying in perfect geometric circles at midnight.

physical_description.visual_profile: A compact charging/control dock resembling a sleek insect hive with 20 palm-sized biomimetic micro-drones. Each drone has a chitinous composite body tapering to a needle-like tail, with four articulated carbon-fiber wings folded at rest. The central hub is a brushed titanium-aluminum cylinder with softly glowing thermal ports.
physical_description.dimensions: Hub: 12cm tall × 8cm diameter. Individual drones: 4cm wingspan, 2.5cm body length
physical_description.weight_description: Complete set (hub + 20 drones + charger): 1.5kg — easily handheld or stashed in cargo vest pocket
physical_description.primary_material: Drone chassis: bio-polymer composite with graphene-reinforced panels. Hub: brushed titanium-aluminum alloy. Wings: carbon-fiber filament
physical_description.finish: Matte black with iridescent oil-slick gradients on wing surfaces. Thermal ports glow soft amber when active. Charging contacts are polished gunmetal
physical_description.color_scheme: Deep charcoal/matte black primary; accent colors include soft amber (thermal indicators), electric blue (status LEDs), and faint chromatic shimmer on wings catching light
physical_description.interface_elements: Hub features: 4 radial LED rings (green/yellow/red status), recessed touch-sensitive launch pad, micro-USB charging port, paired Bluetooth/neural-link antenna coil visible through translucent panel. Individual drones have: single IR emitter lens (clear), thermal sensor array (dark red tint), motion-detector opening (microperforated)
distinctive_features: Insectoid silhouette — wings designed to mimic wasp morphology for psychological deterrent
Barely-visible IR emitter on each drone's forward pod glows faintly during active alert mode
Thermal-reactive paint on wings shows heat signature patterns when drones are in operation
Interlocking magnetic charging cradles inside hub — drones dock vertically like ammunition in magazine
Whisper-quiet: wing design produces subsonic vortices rather than audible flutter
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: VESPID DYNAMICS logo (stylized wasp head) on hub front in recessed metallic inlay. Serial number on rear. Tier-2+ certification stamp. FCC-equivalent regulatory marks (GLMZ Authority) on base
physical_description.condition_typical: Active: drones in rotation, 10 airborne at any time, others docked and charging. Thermal ports cycling through amber-to-dim. LED ring breathing gentle green. Idle: all drones docked, single blue status LED, minimal heat signature
